messages:
Maria K: :rotating_light: Seeing multiple missed pages for prod-sms-eu. Pager shows deliveries but oncall never got a phone page. Customer reports delayed incident response.
Sam T: checked the incident logs, notify-bus returned 202 but the incident-broker shows 'dropped: payload-sanitizer' around the same time window.
Jordan P: any recent changes to the slack-proxy or message-size sanitizer?
Lee R: pushed a PR last night that added an attachment size guard on the outbound notifier to avoid oversized SMS multipart. Could be related.
Maria K: timeline: alerts started at ~17:20 UTC, several customers affected (two enterprise tenants) — support saw complaints at 17:35.
Alex S (support): customers reported no page for severity P1, they only saw Slack thread. They expected phone + SMS.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1327. Pager attempt logged but status=skipped (reason=message_filtered).
Sam T: paste of last notify-broker log: ```[2026-03-17T17:22:10Z] notify-broker: send attempt tenant=acme-eu channel=sms payload_len=18432 validator=attachment_suppressor result=skipped code=MSG_FILTERED```
Jordan P: interesting — validator flags large JSON in attachment (we added that rule) and now it returns 'skipped' instead of falling back to phone-only. That behavior changed last night in notifier v2.1.
Lee R: I changed the rule to avoid sending >16KB attachments via SMS, but forgot to add a fallback path for pager channels. The notifier assumed channel=slack only.
Maria K: impact: 4 P1 pages missed, two manual escalations required. We need immediate mitigation and a postmortem.
Sam T: mitigation options: 1) rollback notifier v2.1, 2) flip feature flag to disable attachment_suppressor, 3) patch fallback to route to phone-only when sms skipped.
Lee R: I can flip the flag for EU immediately. Where's the toggle?
Jordan P: deploy console -> feature-flags -> notifier. Flag name: notifier.attachment_suppressor_enabled.
Maria K: Lee, please flip and confirm. Sam, prepare rollback play if flag flip doesn't restore pages. Alex, keep customers updated.
Lee R: flipped flag for eu-prod at 17:46 UTC. Notifier now accepting payloads.
Sam T: I'm seeing outgoing pages being scheduled now. oncall-bot sent a test page at 17:48 and it went through.
oncall-bot: Page delivered to +44-7700-xxxxxx for oncall.
Alex S (support): told customers we'll be restoring paging within ~10 min and following up with root cause and remediation plan. They acknowledged.
Maria K: creating incident timeline and escalation notes in INC ticket. Add action items: revert permanent fix (add explicit phone fallback), add test for attachment_skips in staging, and add alert when pager attempts are skipped.
Jordan P: I'll open a PR for phone-fallback logic and a unit test.
Sam T: capture metrics: count of 'skipped' per channel and tenant, add an SLO alert if skipped_pages_rate > 0.1% for 5m.
Lee R: next steps: hotfix + proper fallback, postmortem draft, and ensure feature flags have owner/alerting.
Maria K: thanks everyone. I'll follow up in the incident ticket with customer impact details. :thumbsup:
Sam T: small note for retro: make sure behavior change (skip vs fallback) is in changelog. This caused the silent failure.
Jordan P: agreed. I'll include a regression test in CI.
Maria K: closing the realtime coordination thread — leave any follow-ups in INC-2026-1327.
